assets.title: RimLayers 封面
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: square release cover / RimWorld mod About/Preview.png, 1536 x 1536.
Create finished premium illustrated cover for the mod "RimLayers". Core idea: expand a small frontier colony upwards into two upper floors, and excavate two underground levels. One continuous connected colony, not floating disconnected islands.
Composition: upper third large exceptionally legible title, central two thirds carefully designed isometric cutaway of a compact lived-in sci-fi colony and the earth beneath. Show EXACTLY three above-ground usable floor levels (ground, second and third), supported steel-and-timber rooms on columns and walls with stair connections. Ground agricultural courtyard, middle workshop, upper sleeping rooms. Below ground show two excavated tunnel levels with stone strata, small independent mineral seams and wooden stair entrances. Stairs are functional short staircases with timber steps and gray steel rails. A small teal industrial single-floor lift can be visible. All above-ground platforms visibly supported, all underground rooms carved in rock. Small faceless pawn-like colonists carry supplies; no realistic detailed humans.
Style: beautifully inked, hand-painted isometric strategy-game architectural diorama; crisp silhouettes, tactile modest steel, wood and rough stone, flat clean shapes with subtle painterly depth. Not a screenshot, not photorealistic, no UI. Warm habitation lights against cool slate earth, muted teal industrial accents, warm amber wayfinding. Quiet dark charcoal background, ivory title, restrained fine engineering guide rules and plenty of breathing room. Cohesive, mature and inviting, not a busy movie poster.
Text verbatim: top small "RIMWORLD 1.7"; main very large "RimLayers"; below title medium "向上建造 · 向下开拓"; bottom tiny but readable "封面概念图".
Do not add other text or labels. No official RimWorld logo, no ships, no unsupported floating platforms, no extra floor levels, no battle, no watermark. Square image. Keep title and essential subject inside generous 8% margins for thumbnail cropping. Chinese must be accurate.

assets.title: 物品吊篮
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: polished Chinese feature-introduction card for the README of the RimLayers RimWorld 1.7 mod. Create a NEW landscape image, 1536 x 1024.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE: the existing RimLayers vertical-lift card. Match its dark graphite / blue-black background, warm ivory typography, amber wayfinding, restrained cyan electrical accents, outlined hand-painted isometric cutaway illustration, generous margins and editorial hierarchy. Do not copy its lift, costs, text, research requirements or passenger elevator.
Input image 2 is a FUNCTION / VISUAL IDENTITY REFERENCE: actual game screenshot with small wooden winch hoists and metal motor hoists. Use only the wood-versus-metal identity and distinction between open basket and closed port. Do not reproduce the game HUD, buildings, camera view or text.
Primary request: introduce an ITEM-ONLY cargo hoist: pawns manually haul goods into ONE physical basket, another-floor pawn calls it, waits for travel and loading time, then takes real goods and continues work. It never carries people and never automatically collects goods from distant warehouses.
Composition: upper left small brand line, then large Chinese title and short English subtitle. Main left 58%: a clear two-floor isometric cutaway of a compact sealed wooden cargo shaft with a manual winch and hand crank. Exactly ONE small cargo basket inside this shaft, currently docked on the lower floor, visibly containing steel bars and a little wood. The upper access port is CLOSED and has NO duplicate basket, NO goods. A stylized adult colonist stands on the lower FLOOR OUTSIDE the shaft carrying a small bundle toward the access; a second adult stands on the upper FLOOR OUTSIDE the shaft waiting beside the closed access. Both figures remain safely outside the basket. One slender amber up/down travel arrow confined to the shaft. Emphasize furniture-sized 1x1 ports, not a large passenger elevator. Floors are visibly supported. Clean readable illustration, not a screenshot.
Right 42%: three clear typographic facts separated by fine rules with small simple icons. Under them two compact illustrated variant tokens: wooden hand-crank icon for manual, steel frame with a small cyan motor for electric. These tokens are isolated comparison icons, not extra baskets in the main shaft.
Bottom band: two connection badges and a simple numbered three-step workflow, with no extra paragraphs.
Text must be EXACT and crisp, using readable Chinese sans-serif for facts, matching the reference's elegant title treatment. Do not add any other claims, numbers or text.
Small brand line: "RimLayers / 建造手册"
Large title: "物品吊篮"
Subtitle: "CARGO HOISTS"
Right facts, three separate lines: "先搬入，再跨层取用" / "一条井道，一只篮子" / "每篮 3 堆 · 装卸各 30 tick"

Ramp is horizontal length six grid units, rise three height units, constructed from several parallel one-cell-wide lane modules to fit the entire vehicle.
